skill.name: jira-automation
skill.description: Automate Jira issue, project, sprint, board, comment, and user workflows through Rube MCP and Composio.
skill.summary: Guide AI agents through Jira automation workflows using Rube MCP tools and current Jira schemas.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are false positives from Markdown inline code in a documentation-only SKILL.md. Remaining risks are the disclosed third-party Rube MCP endpoint and Jira operations that can change issues, sprints, comments, and project roles.

remediation.issue: Third-party MCP endpoint and Jira OAuth flow
remediation.suggestion: Document the external service, expected Jira scopes, and data handling expectations before users connect their Jira instance.
Require explicit user confirmation before creating, editing, assigning, commenting, sprint changes, or role changes.
Recommend least-privilege Jira accounts and avoid broad administrator scopes for routine automation.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Jira connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `jira`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
2. `JIRA_GET_ISSUE` - Get full details of a specific issue [Optional]
- `jql`: JQL query string (e.g., `project = PROJ AND status = "In Progress"`)
- `fields`: Array of field names to return
- Custom fields use IDs like `customfield_10001`, not display names
- Results are paginated; check `total` vs `startAt + maxResults` to continue
1. `JIRA_GET_ALL_PROJECTS` - List projects to find project key [Prerequisite]
2. `JIRA_GET_FIELDS` - Get available fields and their IDs [Prerequisite]
4. `JIRA_EDIT_ISSUE` - Update fields on an existing issue [Optional]
- `description`: Issue description (Atlassian Document Format or plain text)
2. `JIRA_ADD_COMMENT` - Add a comment to an issue [Required]
- `body`: Comment body (supports ADF for rich text)
- Check `total` in response to determine remaining pages
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party MCP Handles Jira Access
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs users to add rube.app/mcp and complete Jira OAuth through Rube. This external service may broker Jira data and should be trusted before use.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The setup instructions explicitly identify the external MCP endpoint and Jira OAuth flow. No hidden exfiltration was found, so the concern is disclosed third-party trust.

semantic_findings.description: The skill directs agents to create, edit, assign, comment on, and move issues, create sprints, and add users to project roles. Mistaken agent actions can alter project data or permissions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited workflows explicitly include write and role-management operations. These actions are legitimate, but they carry business-impact risk when delegated to an agent.

content.user_title: Automate Jira Workflows Through Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Jira work often requires repeated tool calls and exact field names. This skill guides AI agents through issue, sprint, comment, project, and user workflows.
actual_capabilities: Search Jira issues with JQL and retrieve issue details.
Create, edit, and assign Jira issues after project fields are known.
List boards and sprints, move issues, and create sprints.
List existing comments and add comments to Jira issues.
Find users and manage project role membership.
Handle pagination, custom field IDs, and Jira account IDs.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Jira connection.
Cannot bypass Jira permissions or OAuth scopes.
Tool schemas can change, so tool discovery is required first.
Write actions should be reviewed before execution.

use_cases.title: Triage Jira Backlogs
use_cases.description: Find issues by project, status, assignee, label, priority, or date and summarize the results for planning.

use_cases.title: Prepare Sprint Updates
use_cases.description: List boards and sprints, move selected issues, and create new sprints with checked dates.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Support Follow-Up
use_cases.description: Create issues, add comments, assign owners, and find users while respecting Jira field requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Find Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my Jira project for open high priority bugs. Show issue keys, summaries, assignees, and status. Do not change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Jira task for the release checklist. First confirm the project, issue type, required fields, summary, description, and assignee.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Sprint
prompt_templates.prompt: List available boards and sprints, then help move approved backlog issues into the target sprint after I confirm the issue list.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Project Access
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Jira project roles and candidate users. Propose role changes only, and wait for explicit approval before making updates.

output_examples.input: Find open high priority bugs in a project.
output: A concise issue list with keys, summaries, statuses, assignees, and priority.
A note when more results are available through pagination.

output_examples.input: Create a bug report for a login failure.
output: A confirmation draft with project, issue type, summary, description, and owner.
A final Jira issue key after the user approves creation.

output_examples.input: Prepare sprint cleanup for selected tickets.
output: A proposed sprint move list grouped by current status.
A warning for issues that need field or permission checks.

best_practices: Search for current tool schemas before every workflow.
Confirm project keys, field IDs, and account IDs before write actions.
Ask for explicit approval before any Jira change.
anti_patterns: Do not create or edit issues without showing the planned changes first.
Do not assume display names match Jira field IDs or account IDs.
Do not paginate partially when the user requests complete results.

faq.question: Does this skill require Jira credentials?
faq.answer: It requires an active Jira connection through Rube MCP. Jira permissions still control what actions can run.

faq.question: Can it create and edit Jira issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents create, edit, assign, comment, sprint, and role workflows that should use confirmation before execution.

faq.question: Does it support custom Jira fields?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs agents to discover field IDs because custom fields often differ from display names.

faq.question: Can it search issues with JQL?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes JQL search guidance, pagination handling, and common filters for project, status, assignee, labels, and priority.

faq.question: Is this only for Jira Software?
faq.answer: Issue and project workflows are broader. Board and sprint workflows require Jira Software features.

faq.question: Why must tools be searched first?
faq.answer: Rube MCP tool schemas can change. Searching first helps the agent use current parameters and avoid stale calls.
